graph.title: Car 30103-1
notes: The booklet is small and several pieces (p17 bracket, p1 grille tile, p11 pink tile, clip plates, seat panels, p8) are ambiguous. Their positions are my best estimate, simplified so nothing overlaps.
Model front (row 0) is the side facing the viewer. The car nose points to the left (low column). Base p3 is turned 90 so its 7-stud length runs along the columns, with its top studs at layer 3.

To avoid overlaps I put the pink tiles p9 and p10 on the base's top studs instead of down in the recess. I also put the yellow and gray plates p4 and p5 under the rear wheel arch p23, and the front mudguard p16 directly on the base studs. The booklet shows the yellow plate under the front mudguard, so this is a deviation.

Wheels and tyres are not joined by stacking. Wheels sit on the base wheel pins, and each tyre is stretched over its wheel rim. They are joined in other_joins, so separate groups in the stacking graph are expected. The tyre/wheel overlap is real, not an error.
The minifigure (Emma) is not in the piece list and is not recorded.

graph_initial.title: Car 30103-1
notes: The booklet is small and several pieces are ambiguous; the front/rear arrangement is my best reading. Model front (row 0) is the side of the car facing the viewer, and the car nose points to the left (low column).
Base p3 is turned 90 so its length runs along columns (7 studs) and its recess (3x4) is in columns 2-4.
Positions of p17 (bracket), p1 (grille tile), p11 (pink front tile), p14/p15 (clip plates) and p24/p18 (seat panels) are estimated from small pictures. Offsets are guesses.
Layers are shifted so the wheels and tyres are lowest (layer 0) and the base sits at layer 1.
Minifigure (Emma) is not in the piece list and is not recorded.
